name: ai-router-vscode
description: Send coding work to the local AI Router control service.

aiRouter.includeSelection.description: Offer the active text selection as task context.

aiRouter.provider.description: Optional AI Router provider ID; blank keeps automatic routing.

aiRouter.profile.description: Optional AI Router profile ID selected in the dashboard.

aiRouter.model.description: Optional model ID exposed by the selected AI Router profile.

aiRouter.executionChannel.description: Optional execution channel selected through AI Router.

aiRouter.reasoningEffort.description: Optional task-level reasoning effort override validated by AI Router.
